title: SUNSET — Support once. Share forever.
short_description: Pool capped sponsorship to release a verified offline learning resource, or claim a refund. Transfer a stewardship NFT to hand over recovery-mirror maintenance without restricting public access or changing who receives the funds.
problem: Shared resources can remain dependent on their original operator even after funding. Communities need an inspectable release agreement and a way to maintain discovery after hosting changes.
demonstration: Open the verified live Released campaign and inspect the pinned contract/code hash.
Show finalized 0.06 + 0.04 testNEAR funding, matching release and native 0.1-testNEAR creator payout with completed callback.
Recover the original and steward-selected mirror against the same commitments; download the standalone game.
Show real NFT handover, former-owner mirror rejection and new-owner mirror selection.
Open the actual downloaded file in a fresh browser with browser network offline before load; complete all five questions.
Label both expiry refunds and protocol failure/max-state scenarios as remaining live evidence; local rehearsal covers those mechanisms only.
